name: SizeFinderRuler
job: A draggable ruler where the visitor slides to their measurement (foot length, chest, ring) and the recommended size lights up with a note
visitor_action: drag the ruler or use arrow keys; tap a tick
mobile: horizontal drag ruler with big readout
motion: ruler scrolls with momentum and snaps to ticks, size badge swaps with a small pop (reduced-motion: no momentum, instant badge)
art_direction: Precision instrument: paper readout panel and graphite ground, one signal-yellow beam, a quiet ruler strip; the size is the single hero
